articles.headline: Sergio Agüero record broken by 14-year-old in Argentina
articles.description: Aged 14 years and 29 days, Deportivo Riestra midfielder Mateo Apolonio shattered a historic record on Thursday, becoming the youngest player ever to appear in Argentina's First Division.
